text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Now then. How does our new "Ultra Low-Fat 
Teriyaki Bowl" taste, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If this works, it should be the perfect 
carb-loading meal, and thoroughly 
satisfying to boot. Fufu, well 
then—itadakimasu!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...... How should I put it... I think I 
finally understand... what they mean by 
"chase two hares and you will catch 
neither."
